projects.name: Vesserith
projects.summary: The stable public namespace, evidence map, and navigation layer for independent Vesserith projects.

evidence.label: Deployment observed
evidence.detail: GitHub Actions published the read-only hub from commit 528d3aa288c72737478636b9d72923d520a98541; the default Pages URL, all five project routes, and exact build provenance were observed.

boundaries: Owns the public registry, navigation, domain map, and cross-repository decisions.
Does not own product runtime state, private records, or credentials.
Remains useful when every product application is unavailable.
projects.nextGate: Maintain Pages as the durable static evidence surface; introduce Sites only when an approved capability requires interactivity, authentication, or persistence.

projects.name: Mynyra
projects.summary: An offline-first trading control room and engine, and the first proving ground for Nyvora hypotheses.

evidence.label: Repository observed
evidence.detail: The public UI is static and disconnected from the imported engine; current proof is provider-free and non-trading.

boundaries: Current public experience is static presentation, not an engine cockpit.
Offline proof requires provider and order permissions to remain false.
No Sites surface may become a trading or credential boundary.
projects.nextGate: Generate sanitized, commit-bound offline evidence without introducing a product backend.

projects.name: Nyvora
projects.summary: A domain-independent coordination and kernel project with an adopted baseline and a separate forward hypothesis.

evidence.label: Architecture observed
evidence.detail: v1.0.1 is adopted architecture, not deployment proof. v2.0.0-alpha.1 remains an unqualified hypothesis.

boundaries: v1.0.1 is adopted architecture, not a software release or deployment claim.
The current implementation is a legacy candidate and does not conform to the adopted baseline.
v2.0.0-alpha.1 remains offline, proposed, and unauthorized for E1 or E2.
projects.nextGate: Create an isolated E0 conformance harness and attempt to falsify the v2 hypothesis.

versions.label: v0.2.1
versions.detail: Historical design label supplied by the operator; repository source evidence is missing.

versions.label: v1.0.1
versions.detail: Corrected architecture baseline; not implementation or operational proof.

versions.label: v2.0.0-alpha.1
versions.detail: Not implemented, adopted, qualified, production-ready, or authorized for live experiments.

projects.name: Hova
projects.summary: The Tracker application, moving toward one authenticated owner after source and data lineage reconciliation.

evidence.label: Reconciliation pending
evidence.detail: Adjacent Sites, SQLite, Manus, and Android lineages are preserved evidence; none is canonical yet.

boundaries: The declared Hova repository is a shell; adjacent implementations are preserved evidence.
No source or persistent store becomes canonical before read-only reconciliation.
The first canonical application is single-user and independently authenticated.
projects.nextGate: Inventory Sites D1 and self-hosted SQLite authority without exposing record content.

projects.name: wadewolfie
projects.summary: Vahid's future public profile and a human entry point into the projects gathered under Vesserith.

evidence.label: Direction recorded
evidence.detail: The profile surface is part of the approved domain map; no public implementation is claimed.

boundaries: Owns personal public narrative, not ecosystem authority.
Shares navigation and provenance conventions with the Vesserith hub.
No profile implementation or publication is currently claimed.
projects.nextGate: Define public profile content before creating a separate Sites deployment.
